summary: Completed storefront and admin smoke testing against the public preview. Home, product detail actions, cart controls, checkout success, auctions, category browsing, admin dashboard, mobile menu, and mobile overflow checks passed. Product-detail cart navigation is broken.

integration_issues.issue: Clicking the header cart button on /product/iphone does not navigate to /cart because ProductPage renders Topbar without an onCart handler. This blocked the natural product -> cart -> checkout flow.

action_items: Pass a cart navigation handler to Topbar on ProductPage, or make the shared cart button link to /cart, then retest the complete product-to-checkout flow.
critical_code_review_comments: ProductPage uses Topbar cartCount=2 without onCart, while StoreHome explicitly supplies onCart; shared header behavior is inconsistent across routes.

success_rate.backend: N/A (no backend integration; demo state is intentional)

seed_data_creation: None; all product, cart, auction, checkout, and admin data remained local demo state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview tested at desktop and 390px mobile. Direct cart, checkout, auction, category, admin dashboard, and mobile admin menu flows passed. Re-run the natural product detail cart-header flow after fixing navigation.
rca of the issue: In App.js, ProductPage renders <Topbar cartCount={2}/> without the onCart prop. Topbar's cart button only invokes onCart and is not itself a Link, so the click is a no-op on product pages.
